issues.source_clause: I2.1.1 application as referenced by I2.1.2.2
issues.source_excerpt: This UR applies to Polar Class ships according to UR I1.
issues.reason: The shape targets every nltl:ship and documents that applicability is not independently re-certified, but it does not represent or constrain the UR I1 applicability condition. The caller declaration is only an experimental population assumption and cannot independently establish legal or source-defined eligibility. The displacement and greatest-waterline logic can therefore be reviewed for admitted records, but complete applicability enforcement for the represented source obligation remains unresolved.
issues.expected: Either applicability must be explicitly represented and enforced for the targeted population, or the review scope must provide a source/schema-backed applicability binding that makes the admitted target population legally or requirement-wise eligible.
issues.suggestion: Add a schema-supported applicability selector and enforce it on the root target, or retain this as an explicitly limited research-scope shape and provide the required applicability context before treating the implementation as complete.
